message.content: I've noticed some darker skin over my knuckles and knees. I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or cough. As for the other symptoms you listed, like tiredness, weight loss, nausea, dizziness or salt craving, nothing was mentioned in what I was told, so I'm not sure. I don't know exactly why the scan was done or how the nodules were found. About my history: five years ago I was in the hospital for a spot on my chest X-ray, but I was never told I had tuberculosis and I wasn't treated for it. I've never taken steroids, and no one in my family has any inherited diseases. I don't know about any cancer or autoimmune problems like thyroid disease, type 1 diabetes or vitiligo, and none were mentioned.
